const geminiResponse = $(' Create Kie.ai Task').item.json; const recommendationData = $('Loop Over Recommendations').item.json; let base64Data = null; let mimeType = 'image/jpeg'; console.log('Full Gemini Response:', JSON.stringify(geminiResponse, null, 2)); if (geminiResponse.candidates && geminiResponse.candidates[0] && geminiResponse.candidates[0].content && geminiResponse.candidates[0].content.parts) { for (const part of geminiResponse.candidates[0].content.parts) { if (part.inlineData && part.inlineData.data) { base64Data = part.inlineData.data; mimeType = part.inlineData.mimeType || 'image/jpeg'; console.log('Found image data, size:', base64Data.length, 'chars'); break; } } } if (!base64Data) { console.error('Gemini response structure:', JSON.stringify(geminiResponse.candidates[0].content.parts, null, 2)); throw new Error('No image data found in Gemini response. Check console logs for response structure.'); } const buffer = Buffer.from(base64Data, 'base64'); const recId = recommendationData.id || 'unknown'; const filename = `${recId}_generated.jpg`; console.log('Successfully converted image:'); console.log('- Recommendation ID:', recId); console.log('- Image size (bytes):', buffer.length); console.log('- MIME type:', mimeType); console.log('- Filename:', filename); return [{ json: { recommendationId: recId, imageSize: buffer.length, mimeType: mimeType }, binary: { data: { data: buffer.toString('base64'), mimeType: mimeType, fileName: filename, fileExtension: mimeType.split('/')[1] || 'jpg' } } }];
